name: Underdog
overview: Scripture reveals that God often chooses the seemingly weak or lowly to accomplish His purposes, as seen when He reassured Moses to trust in His salvation despite overwhelming odds (Exodus 14:13) and directed Gideon to reduce his army so that victory would be attributed to divine power, not human strength (Judges 7:2). The Lord upholds and strengthens those who are fearful or meek (Isaiah 41:10; Matthew 5:5), exalted over the proud and mighty (Luke 1:52), and calls His people to place their trust in Him rather than earthly power or resources (Psalms 20:7). This teaches believers that true victory and blessing come from reliance on God, not human might.
